The acoustic guitar provides a warm, consistent harmonic bed. (4) The narration continues seamlessly into scheduled feeding topics. Occasional soft sounds of cats licking or rhythmic chewing are mixed subtly into the audio track, blended with the BGM to add realism. (5) The video concludes with a friendly sign-off phrase delivered with a high arousal level. The background music maintains its pace until a final musical cadence leads to silence at the end.
